Claims (11)
-----------

The invention claimed is:

1. A compound represented by the formula:

[![Figure US09512105-20161206-C00017](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0a/01/38/6eec682b83e731/US09512105-20161206-C00017.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/0a/01/38/6eec682b83e731/US09512105-20161206-C00017.png)

 

wherein

W, X, Y and Z are, independently, hydrogen, C1-3 alkyl, OC1-3 alkyl, F, OH, Br, Cl, CN, CF3, NO2, SO2CH3, SO2CF3 or SO2NH2.

2. The compound of claim 1, wherein W, X, Y and Z are, independently, hydrogen, methyl, methoxy, F, Cl or OH.

3. The compound of claim 1, wherein W, V, X, Y and Z are, independently, hydrogen, methyl, Cl or OH.

4. The compound of claim 1, wherein W is hydrogen, methyl or Cl.

5. The compound of claim 1, wherein X is hydrogen, methoxy or OH.

6. The compound of claim 1, wherein Y is hydrogen, methyl or methoxy.

7. The compound of claim 1, wherein Z is hydrogen, F, methyl or methoxy.

8. The compound of claim 1, which is represented by the formula:

[![Figure US09512105-20161206-C00018](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/31/9f/b7/a4a49a0b397be3/US09512105-20161206-C00018.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/31/9f/b7/a4a49a0b397be3/US09512105-20161206-C00018.png)

9. The compound of claim 1, which is represented by the formula:

[![Figure US09512105-20161206-C00019](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b8/e7/f1/09d7c6052b51ee/US09512105-20161206-C00019.png)](https://patentimages.storage.googleapis.com/b8/e7/f1/09d7c6052b51ee/US09512105-20161206-C00019.png)

10. The compound of claim 1, which is a pharmaceutically acceptable salt.

11. A pharmaceutical composition, comprising the compound of claim 1 and a pharmaceutically acceptable carrier.
